ui.ws.appointment_mail.own_text_hint.de-CH: Zum Beispiel, wo man parkiert oder was mitzubringen ist.
ui.ws.appointment_mail.own_text_hint.en-US: For example where to park or what to bring.

ui.ws.appointment_mail.privacy.de-CH: Die Mails nennen nur Arbeitsbereich, Datum, Uhrzeit und Adresse – nie Behandlung, Leistung oder Notizen.
ui.ws.appointment_mail.privacy.en-US: The mails name only the workspace, date, time and address – never treatment, service or notes.

ui.ws.appointment_mail.contact_hint.de-CH: Wenn der Arbeitsbereich sie verschickt (Einstellungen › E-Mail).
ui.ws.appointment_mail.contact_hint.en-US: When the workspace sends them (Settings › E-mail).

ui.ws.appointment_mail.contact_no_email.de-CH: Ohne E-Mail-Adresse gehen keine Terminmails raus.
ui.ws.appointment_mail.contact_no_email.en-US: Without an e-mail address no appointment mails go out.

ui.ws.write_mail.text.en-US: To {email} – what would you like to write with?

ui.ws.write_mail.clinks_hint.en-US: From your or the business address; the mail is filed under “Sent” at the contact.

ui.ws.write_mail.system_hint.de-CH: Outlook, Apple Mail, Gmail – was dein System für E-Mail-Links verwendet.
ui.ws.write_mail.system_hint.en-US: Outlook, Apple Mail, Gmail – whatever your system uses for e-mail links.

ui.ws.contacts.merge_rest.en-US: Tags are combined; appointments, tasks, mails and invoices move to the contact that stays.

ui.ws.spitex.activity_hint.de-CH: Welche Tätigkeit ist bei diesem Besuch geplant?
ui.ws.spitex.activity_hint.en-US: What activity is planned for this visit?

ui.ws.spitex.period_limit.en-US: Plan up to 93 days at a time. Existing visits keep their schedule.
